name: mmc-mms-monorepo
description: Medical Committee frontend repository (paired with external love-api backend).

scripts.dev: npm run check:workspaces && npm run dev --workspace frontend
scripts.build: npm run check:workspaces && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.preview: npm run check:workspaces && npm run preview --workspace frontend
scripts.lint: npm run check:workspaces && npm run lint --workspace frontend
scripts.test: npm run check:workspaces && npm run test --workspace frontend
